text:
tamir: Originating RC rc-20240712-opsfix at artifact sha:77aa88bb. This is a small operational tweak: reduce KV cache cold-start window + adjust autoscaler headroom for dedicated pools. Change window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Need quick signoff and a sheriff for the quiet window.

deploy-bot: [CI] rc-20240712-opsfix build succeeded. Tests: unit/integration/smoke all green. Release notes draft: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20240712-opsfix

nina: confirm no DB migrations and feature flags are scoped?

tamir: No DB work. Flags scoped to tag 'dedicated-opsfix'. snippet: `config.kv.cold_start_ms = { scope: "dedicated-opsfix" }`

ops: I'll take sheriff. Provide commit, rollback artifact, and abort thresholds.

tamir: commit sha: 77aa88bb. rollback artifact: sha:1122ffee (rc-stable). Abort if error rate >1% or p99 latency +45% for 10m. Deadman 25m. Playbook: /runbooks/release-rollback.md

qa-engineer: Quick smoke on staging done. rerank suite passes. p99 +6ms. QA +1 for canary.

release-coordinator: reminder to pin artifact after final promote and include ops note about autoscaler headroom.

deploy-bot: Promote command sample:
```
/deploy promote --env=prod --rc=rc-20240712-opsfix --artifact=sha:77aa88bb \
  --canary-stages=3,30,100 --quiet-window=01:00-02:00UTC --deadman=25m \
  --notify=@ops --notes-url=https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20240712-opsfix
```

nina: propose canary profile: 3% for 8m, 30% for 18m, then 100% if green. Watch metrics: rerank_exact_match, p99 latency, and autoscaler CPU headroom.

ops: agreed. I'll monitor dash and have oncall ready.

tamir: Kicking promotion now. @deploy-bot please.

deploy-bot: ACTION by tamir: scheduled promotion at 01:05 UTC. Stage 1: 3% canary deploy starting... done. Health: passing.

qa-engineer: quick smoke on canary OK. No diffs in topk rerank.

deploy-bot: Stage 2: moving to 30% traffic. Rolling update in progress... routing updated. Health: passing; telemetry shows normal error rates.

ops: watching. minor p99 blip in one region, still below abort. error rate 0.25%.

release-coordinator: remind to pin artifact on success: rc/fix/20240712.

tamir: if green after 15m we move to 100%.

deploy-bot: Stage 3: promoting to 100% traffic. Rolling update across zones; ETA ~7m.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All regions at rc-20240712-opsfix artifact sha:77aa88bb. Post-deploy checks show green.

nina: Verified no pressure on DB connections, autoscaler headroom normalized. Memory stable.

qa-engineer: starting extended evals (30m). will flag any cohort regressions.

ops: marking rollout stable. deadman canceled. Logging this for release audit.

tamir: pinning artifact to rc/fix/20240712 and updating changelog with note on autoscaler headroom.

release-coordinator: Done: artifact pinned and release notes published. Link: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20240712-opsfix#changelog

deploy-bot: Postdeploy watch active for 30m. Automatic rollback will open ticket if thresholds exceeded. Rollback command:
```
/deploy rollback --env=prod --to-artifact=sha:1122ffee --reason="regression or abort - rc-20240712-opsfix"
```

qa-engineer: FYI small 0.15% dip in one rerank cohort; filing EV-4987 for follow-up. Not blocking.

tamir: thanks @qa-engineer. we'll triage EV-4987 in next patch unless it drifts. Closing thread for now but will keep release notes linked. :rocket:
